x-k-k10-01.title: Chirevo chimwe, manzwiro maviri
x-k-k10-01.goal: Fungidzira zvinoreva zvakafanana zvinotaurwa zve 손이 크다 kubva mumitsara mitatu, sarudza kwainotakura kuzunungusa, uye utsanangure nehumbowo hwakareketwa kuti sei manzwiro akasiyana.
x-k-k10-01.material:
Vanhu vatatu vari kutaura nezvemumwe munhu. Chirevo chimwechete 손이 크다 chinoonekwa nguva dzose (HACHINA kutsanangurwa pano).
(가) 엄마는 손이 커서 김장할 때마다 이웃 몫까지 넉넉하게 담그세요.
(나) 동생은 손이 커서 월급날이면 친구들에게 밥을 사다가 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요.
(다) 새 요리사는 손이 커서 찌개를 끓이면 늘 열 명 분이 나와서 매번 반이 남아요.
x-k-k10-01.thinking.0: Kufungidzira zvinoreva chirevo kubva mumamiriro ezvinhu akati wandei
x-k-k10-01.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga mitsara yeKorea ine -아서/-어서 ne -(으)ㄹ 때마다
x-k-k10-01.prereq.1: Unoziva kuti Korea ine zvirevo zvakasimbiswa zvine zvinoreva zvisiri chiverengero chemazwi azvo
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.prompt: Zvinoreva zvikuru zvipi zve 손이 크다 zvinoenderana nemitsara yose mitatu?
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kandira chirevo uye ubvunze kuti mamiriro matatu (김장, 월급날, 찌개) ane chii chakafanana.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Edza sarudzo imwe neimwe nemitsara yose mitatu, kwete iya inonzwika nyore bedzi.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.a: Munhu ane maoko makuru chaizvo anobatsira mukicheni.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.a: Kutora mazwi sezvaakaita. Tarisa (나): muhoro nekutengera shamwari chikafu hazvina chekuita nehukuru hwemaoko.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.b: Munhu ane unyanzvi hwekubika anogadzira chikafu chinonaka mumamiriro ese.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.b: Kunamatira pa (가) ne (다). Tarisa (나): hakuna kubika mairi, saka zvinoreva zvinofanira kuva zvakafara kupfuura kubika.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.c: Munhu anoshandisa mari pasina kufunga nezvemangwana.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.c: Inoenderana ne (나) bedzi. Tarisa (가) ne (다): zvinotaura nezvehuwandu hwechikafu, kwete kushandisa mari zvisina hanya.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.d: Munhu anobata chikafu, mari kana zvipo muhuwandu hukuru, hune ruramwoyo.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.d: Kuvaka zvinoreva zvinoramba zvakakodzera mumamiriro ese matatu, kwete kekutanga bedzi.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.explain: Mumitsara yose mitatu, 손이 크다 inotsanangura munhu anoshandisa, anopa kana anogadzira zvinhu muhuwandu hukuru. Kubika nemari i mamiriro bedzi.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Mumitsara ipi mutauri anotora 손이 크다 sedambudziko rakapfava zvishoma? Sarudza zvese zvinoenderana.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Mumutsara mumwe nemumwe, bvunza kuti mutauri anonzwika sei: akafara, asina kutsaura kana akanetseka?
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Wobva wawana mazwi ari mumutsara anokuita kuti unzwe izvozvo.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.a: Kuverenga 넉넉하게 / 이웃 몫까지 sehumwe hunhu hunodziya, kwete kuzunungusa. Mutsara hauna mhedzisiro isina kunaka.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: Kucherekedza chirevo chemhedzisiro 빠듯해요 (mari yakaoma) chinoita kuti tsika imwechete ive kunetseka.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.c: Kucherekedza 매번 반이 남아요 (hafu inoraswa nguva dzose) semhedzisiro isina kunaka.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Zvinoreva zvikuru zvechirevo hazvina rutivi. Manzwiro anobva pachirevo chemhedzisiro: 빠듯해요 ne 반이 남아요 zvinoratidza dambudziko, nepo 넉넉하게 mu (가) iine ushamwari.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: MuChirungu kana muKorea, tsanangura kuti sei chirevo chimwechete chinonzwika chinodziya mu (가) asi chinonetsa mu (나). Reketa chirevo chimwe cheKorea kana kupfuura kubva mumitsara sehumbowo.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Reketa chirevo chemhedzisiro chemutsara mumwe nemumwe.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakaratidza here mazwi chaiwo anotakura manzwiro?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shamwari yepaklasi ingawana humbowo hwangu mutsamba here?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.0: Mu (가) chirevo 이웃 몫까지 넉넉하게 chinoratidza kugovana, saka kuva neruramwoyo kunorumbidzwa. Mu (나) tsika imwechete inotungamira ku 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요, saka mhedzisiro i dambudziko remari. Chirevo chakafanana; chirevo chemhedzisiro chinochinja manzwiro.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.1: 손이 크다 inongoti anoshandisa zvinhu muhuwandu hukuru. Mu (가) izvozvo zvinobatsira vavakidzani, asi mu (나) 빠듯해요 inoratidza kuti inodhura mukoma mari, saka mutauri anonzwika akanetseka.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.2: (가) 넉넉하게 담그세요 i chipo kuvavakidzani saka chinonzwika chinodziya; (나) 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요 i dambudziko remari saka chinonzwika chinonetsa.

x-k-k10-02.title: Kuverenga musoro wenhau nenhamba dzawo
x-k-k10-02.goal: Tsvaga mutsara muchinyorwa chipfupi chenhau unoti zvakawanda kupfuura zvinotsigirwa nehumbowo, uye unyore patsva musoro wenhau kuti uenderane nedata uye utaure muganho wekutsvaga.
x-k-k10-02.material:
Musoro wenhau: 서울 시민 다수, 대중교통 요금 인상 찬성
(Verenga musoro wenhau kutanga, wobva waverenga mitsara mina yechinyorwa, yakanyorwa kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 4.)
x-k-k10-02.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga muzana nenhamba munhau dzeKorea
x-k-k10-02.prereq.2: Unoziva 다수 (vazhinji / vazhinji kupfuura) ne 과반 (kupfuura hafu)
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.prompt: Mutsara mumwe unoti zvakawanda kupfuura zvinotsigirwa nemitsara yakamberi. Upi?
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa muzana mumutsara wechipiri nemhedziso yakatorwa mune wekupedzisira.
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti vanhu 1,000 vaiva ani chaizvo usati wasarudza kuti vanogona kumiririra ani.
x-k-k10-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 4 ndiwo unodarika. 다수 inonzwika se 'vazhinji', asi 48% i shoma pane hafu uye 41% vakanga vakaramba: 찬성 i boka rakakura zvikuru (plurality), kwete vazhinji. Mutsara 3 unoratidzawo kuti vanhu vakasangana vari pamastesheni echitima panguva yekuita kwehuwandu bedzi ndivo vakapindura, saka havagone kumiririra vagari vese veSeoul.
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva musoro wenhau muKorea kuti uenderane nenhamba, uye wedzera mutsara mumwe (Korea kana Chirungu) unotaura muganho wekutsvaga uku.
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Shandisa nhamba chaidzo dzemutsara 2 panzvimbo yeizwi risina kujeka.
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Musoro wangu wenhau unotaura zvinobvumidzwa ne 48% ne 41% bedzi here?
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Muganho wandakataura unobata nezveavo vakabvunzwa, kwete nyaya here?
x-k-k10-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Muverengi wemusoro wangu wenhau angadashurwa pamusoro pe 'vagari vese' here?

x-k-k10-03.title: Raibhurari ndiyo inokonzera zviyero here?
x-k-k10-03.goal: Sarudza ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwaizobatsira kuedza kana kushandisa raibhurari kunokonzera zviyero zvakakwirira, cherekedza kuverenga kwechikonzero chakadzorerwa, uye unyore mubvunzo mumwe wemutsvaki.
x-k-k10-03.material: Chidimbu chenhau: 한 연구에서 한 달에 도서관을 8번 이상 이용한 학생의 평균 성적이 2번 미만 이용한 학생보다 높았다. 연구자는 "도서관 이용이 성적을 올린다"고 말했다.
x-k-k10-03.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga chidimbu chipfupi chenhau yeKorea
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: Zvokwadi zvekuwedzera zvipi zvaizokubatsira kusarudza kana kushandisa raibhurari KUNOKONZERA zviyero zvakakwirira? Sarudza zvese zvinoenderana.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe bvunza: mhinduro ingachinja here kuti raibhurari ine mukana wakadii wekuva chikonzero?
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti chii chimwe chingasiyana pakati pevanoshandisa raibhurari kazhinji nevashoma.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.a: Kana zviyero zvevadzidzi vamwechete zvakayerwa vasati vatanga nekuvapo kwavo kuraibhurari kazhinji
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Kutsvaga shanduko nenguva muvanhu vamwechete, izvo kuenzanisa kumwe chete kusingagone kuratidza.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.b: Chinhu chinofadza pamusoro pekushandiswa, asi hachikuudzi kana kushandiswa kana chimwe chinhu chiri kuzvigadzira zviyero.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.c: Kana vadzidzi vanoshandisa raibhurari zvakanyanya vatoverenga zvakawanda kana vachikurudzirwa
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.c: Kutsvaga chinhu chechitatu chingatsanangura zvose kushandiswa kweraibhurari nezviyero.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.d: Chiyero chepakati chevadzidzi vese munyika chii
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Chiyero chepakati chenyika chinoratidza kana vadzidzi ava vachijairika, kwete chinokonzera musiyano wavo.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.e: Kana zviyero zvakabva pamarekodhi echikoro kana pakutaura kwevadzidzi pachavo
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.e: Kutarisa kuvimbika kwenhamba dzezviyero; izvi zvinobatsira chirevo chose, kunyangwe zvisiri nezvechikonzero pachacho.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.explain: Kuyedza chikonzero unoda data yepamberi/shure yevadzidzi vamwechete (a) nekutarisa zvimwe zvinhu senguva yekudzidza kana kukurudzirwa (c). Marudzi emabhuku nechiyero chepakati chenyika hazvibatani nechikonzero.
x-k-k10-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kutarisa kuti zviyero zvakayerwa sei (e) kunonzwisisika nekuti kunoedza kuvimbika kwedata, kunyangwe kusingataure chikonzero zvakananga.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.prompt: Muverengi anoti: "Pamwe vadzidzi vane zviyero zvakakwirira vanoda kudzidza, saka vanoenda kuraibhurari zvakanyanya." Pfungwa ipi inoratidzwa nechi?

x-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti sarudzo ipi inotaura nezvemutsetse, kwete kutendeseka kana sampuli.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.a: Kusvetukira kupomera kutsvaga; pfungwa yemuverengi i yemutsetse, kwete kutendeseka.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.b: Kuwandisa kururamisa: kushandura mutsetse hakureve kuti hapana hukama.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.c: Chikonzero chingaenda neimwe nzira: zviyero zvakakwirira (kana tsika dzekudzidza) zvingatungamira mukushandisa raibhurari zvakanyanya.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.d: Vadzidzi vanoda kuverenga bedzi ndivo vakabvunzwa.
x-k-k10-03.s.s2.explain: Muverengi anokurudzira chikonzero chakadzorerwa. Nhamba dzakafanana dzinoenderana nenzira mbiri, ndosaka chirevo chekuti kushandisa raibhurari kunokwidziridza zviyero chichidarika data.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.prompt: MuKorea, nyora mubvunzo UMWE waungabvunza mutsvaki usati wabvuma "도서관 이용이 성적을 올린다".
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza chokwadi chisipo kubva panhanho 1, kana mutsetse unopesana kubva panhanho 2.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti ungada kuziva chii kuti ubvise imwe tsananguro.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mubvunzo wangu unoratidza chokwadi chisipo, kwete kusahadzika bedzi here?

x-k-k10-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Une mutsa, asi inopindura 'ari kunaka' uye inoregeredza mutoro une rutivi rumwe waanotsanangura ne 어쩌겠어.
